description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseDialog' which simplifies creating custom dialogs in an Android app using ViewBinding and Material Design components. It also provides an extension function for setting dialog button click behavior without dismissing the dialog, leveraging Android's lifecycle scope.

classes.name: BaseDialog
classes.description: An abstract generic class for creating dialogs with view binding support, built upon DialogFragment and MaterialAlertDialogBuilder.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Abstract method to create and return a view binding instance.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Overrides DialogFragment's method to create and initialize the dialog with custom view binding.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up references to prevent memory leaks.
